title: Uplift payout: When and how to get third, fourth tranches of aid?

blocks.text: LAPU-LAPU CITY, Cebu — Beneficiaries of the government’s Uplift assistance program can expect their third and fourth cash payouts from late October to November, depending on their beneficiary group and salary credit. The Department of Social Welfare and Development (DSWD) said eligible recipients might receive between ₱4,000 and ₱8,000 in combined assistance, with some payments to be deposited directly into their registered accounts. READ: Who qualifies for the ₱2,000 Uplift assistance?
